schema_note: This document follows the wave10 function-handoff.v1 field set and adds five keys the wave10 shape did not need: the two decompilation_defects_corrected and unresolved_questions lists that carry the corrected evidence, observed_body.instruction_count_source, ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 and implementation.boundary_test.
semantic_label: slot pass: emit a six vertex quad into the indexed painter slot and drain the batch, then run bounded per pass region loops against texture slot two

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x4c
abi.return_contract: the setup path writes only the AL lane at 0x005187a0, so the model returns the widened zero; the pass loop writes a full thirty-two bit signed compare at 0x00518aeb, so the model returns the full width boolean there

observed_body.instruction_count_source: the reviewed staging handoff for this address
instruction_list: read the painter through the system port 0x00401080 and index the three texture slots at +0x10 with the first cursor at +0x10
when the third cursor at +0x18 is zero, start the render, clear the colour write, set the material to 0x00f8b396 and set the vertex limit to two
emit the six quad vertices through 0x005295b0 with the zero, unit and axis pairs and the opaque tone, then flush
compute the remaining part count as the pointer difference between the batch part end and begin divided by three
loop while the count is non-zero: set the vertex limit, emit every indexed vertex from the batch index array with the colour 0xff000000, subtract the taken count and flush
restore the colour write and end the render, set the third cursor to one and return zero
otherwise read the graphics probe through 0x0067dd00 and take the bound eight or two from the vtable slot +0x44 result
clamp the pass count to the remaining span from the second cursor at +0x14 through the third cursor
for each pass, start the render on texture slot two, set the material to 0xfa2f3df4, store the inverse extent pair as the first parameter and bind the slot raster
paint the unit rectangle, end the render and swap the two slots
advance the third cursor and answer one when it passes the second cursor

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the three cursor words of the opaque job state
all ten ports are dependency-only, so the render sequence is unverified in this package
the batch shapes, the vertex pool and the texture slot shapes are opaque; only the offsets and the stride arithmetic are pinned
the graphics probe query at slot +0x44 is the only observed bound and its runtime value is unverified
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation returns a single byte for both paths; the setup path writes only AL through the low lane while the pass loop writes a full thirty-two bit signed compare, so the model returns the widened byte for one and the full width boolean for the other
the decompilation divides the part pointer difference by three once; the assembly recomputes the taken count and subtracts it inside the loop, so the corrected model keeps the loop
the decompilation indexes the batch index array with the raw index; the assembly reads the index word first and then scales the vertex by eight, so the model keeps the two step form

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
